sentences.text: So also the investigating officer be directed to attend the Court with papers of investigation.
d] Liberty to file affidavit in reply before the next date.

e] In the event of arrest of the applicant on or before 11.12.2018 in connection with offences u/s 188,
272, 273, 328 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code and u/s 59(ii) of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006, registered on 29.7.2018 vide Crime No.176/2016 with Police Station, Badnapur Dist.Jalna,
the applicant be released on ad interim anticipatory bail on furnishing bail in the sum of Rs.25,000/- on following conditions:-
i] The applicant shall appear before the officer in-charge of Police Station, Badnapur Dist.Jalna on 3.12.2018 at 11-00 a.m. and thereafter continue to attend the Police Station till 7.12.2018 and cooperate in the investigation.
On and after 8.12.2018, the applicant shall - 4 - attend the Police Station as and when directed by the investigating officer.
ii] The applicant shall not indulge into any act amounting to tampering with the prosecution witnesses and the evidence.
